title: Deliver Grover alerts through NERV's channels
goal: A new and a cleared Grover alert each reach the owner once, with a test across the join (fake Grover MCP server → NERV → inbox/Telegram/push fakes)
acceptance: A new and a cleared Grover alert each reach the owner once, with a test across the join (fake Grover MCP server → NERV → inbox/Telegram/push fakes)

The owner decisions of 2026-11-25 in docs/decisions/grover-alert-delivery.md hold under test: alerts open at the first poll or first seen after a reconnect delivered once as one listing message; 22:00–07:00 quiet hours hold minor alerts while serious ones (pH or EC out of range, a stopped feed, an unknown kind) break through, classified by alert kind; one unreachable message after 15 min and one when contact returns, never a clear
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no personal data.
escalation: A change of gate class, data leaving the base, or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 when opened from the coordinator gap review. Not a measurement. Reassessed 2026-11-25 after the owner decisions: +0.5 h for classifying alerts by kind (probe kinds from grover_overview, the serious/minor table, its test) and the single listing message for the first poll; the unreachable messages and the F-004-T10 order were already in the design.
